items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: The Singing Echoes (inaudible) got the Spindell Brothers.

ctx.x: Brooklyn Sky -- big hit, 'Lord Laid His Hands On Me' -- was a big smash back in those days.
We had the Christian Harmonizers which was one of our top groups. The Singing Echoes (inaudible) got the Spindell Brothers.
